provenance.publicationTitle: Family Food FYE 2024 — UK household and eating out expenditure on food and drink
provenance.methodologyNotes: UKMR deterministic average monthly equivalent: observed weekly GBP * 52 / 12. No rounding before storage; IEEE-754 precision. Display rounding is separate. Denominator and source period unchanged; not an observed calendar-month amount.
limitations: National survey evidence, not city budgets or a household composition model.
Selected source totals and subgroups overlap; no additive UKMR Essentials/Lifestyle mapping is approved.
No household composition or fixed headcount is assigned; no city scope or household total is inferred.
Selected category/group totals overlap. Code levels/label columns are source-native; do not sum all rows.
Diary survey estimates are subject to sampling error and under-reporting. No inflation or behaviour adjustment.
Original release 6 November 2025; current dataset page updated 19 June 2026. FYE 2024 is the source period, not 2026.
